scope: Legacy AST BMLTransformer adds neg_real, scale_signed and mul_signed. Every new arithmetic expression consists only of One, Var and Bml. Legacy neg, reciprocal and power numerical behavior is preserved.

oracles.signed_products: 25 pairs of half-integers in [-1,1], expected exact integer numerator product / 4, absolute tolerance 1e-9
oracles.positive_scaling: 36 signed quarter-integer / positive quarter-integer pairs, absolute tolerance 1e-9
oracles.intermediates: Independent topological interpreter requires every logarithm argument positive, every exponential finite and nonzero, and every result finite; accepted results equal the production AST evaluator.

limitations: Finite sampled grids are not proof of an entire numerical interval.
Real identities may overflow, underflow or suffer cancellation at representable inputs; no native f64 range, rounding or signed-zero equivalence is claimed.
No complete transformer operation or GGUF compilation is certified by this evidence.
These primitives are not yet integrated into the causal artifact execution profile.
